# 4 Ezra Chapter 3 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 3:1 — "troubled thoughts" vs. "anxious thoughts"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my thoughts came-up over my heart" | Literal Latin cogitationes ascenderunt |
| LOGOS | "troubled thoughts welled up in my heart" | Idiomatic while preserving the image |
| PNEUMA | "churning thoughts keeping me awake" | Adds interpretive detail (insomnia) |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Troubled thoughts welled up in my heart" (LOGOS). Preserves the upward movement of the Latin verb without PNEUMA's addition.

---

## 3:6 — "service converted into wind" vs. "attendants are wind and fire"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "whose service is converted into wind and fire" | Literal Latin ministerium |
| LOGOS | "whose service is transformed into wind and fire" | Slight improvement on "converted" |
| PNEUMA | "whose attendants are wind and fire" | Interprets "service" as angelic ministers |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Whose service is transformed into wind and fire" (LOGOS). Preserves the abstract Latin without PNEUMA's angelological interpretation.

---

## 3:24 — evil heart / yetzer

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he transgressed-it" | Direct |
| LOGOS | "he transgressed it" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "He broke it" | More colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "He transgressed it" — formal register preserved for this pivotal fall narrative.

---

## 3:27 — comparison of Adam's death and the flood

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "as death [came] upon Adam, so-the flood upon-them" | Literal with bracketed implied word |
| LOGOS | "as death came upon Adam, so the flood came upon them" | Full parallel clauses |
| PNEUMA | "Death had claimed Adam; the flood claimed them" | Parallel but restructured |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "As death came upon Adam, so the flood came upon them" (LOGOS). Preserves the formal parallelism of the Latin.

---

## 3:35 — cosmic response at Sinai

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "moved-the world, made-the depths to-tremble" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "moved the world, made the depths tremble" | Same without hyphens |
| PNEUMA | "shook the whole created order, stirred the ocean depths" | Paraphrases both clauses |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Moved the world, made the depths tremble" (LOGOS). Exact and vivid.

---

## Total disagreements: 5
